title: Enable manual task creation for Sales Order Agent
summary: The Sales Order Agent now allows users to manually create tasks directly from the Agent Tasks pane using the New action, which opens the existing SOA Create Task page.
key_points: Enable default manual task creation capability for Sales Order Agent
Open SOA Create Task page via New action in Agent Tasks pane
Reuse task-page launch helper from SOA setup page
Manual task creation from uploaded files remains disabled
Updates to metadata provider and setup page configuration
quote: Enable default manual task creation for the Sales Order Agent.
